comments.body: Business Analyst App Store eligibility triage, 2026-05-03 09:02 EDT: assigned this issue to milestone 2, iPad MVP stabilization. The bug affects App Store target-platform evidence because the iPad paired-machine card must show the inspectable local Handrail server endpoint literally, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8788, not a locale-formatted port. Closure evidence should include an iPad simulator validation screenshot or run note confirming the port renders without grouping.

Fixed in the iOS app by rendering paired-machine endpoints as a literal host:port string instead of letting SwiftUI localize the port integer. The shared PairedMachine model now exposes address, and Dashboard/Chats/Settings iPhone+iPad endpoint labels use Text(verbatim: machine.address).

Verification:
- XcodeBuildMCP test_sim -only-testing:HandrailTests/PairedMachineFormattingTests passed 1/1 on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1.
- XcodeBuildMCP full test_sim passed 49/49 on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1.
- XcodeBuildMCP build_run_sim launched Handrail on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), simulator UDID 43913CAF-14DD-45B6-9633-0A9790474FC7.
- Screenshot evidence saved at test-artifacts/issue31-port-format-20260503/ipad-dashboard-port-no-grouping.jpg shows the paired Dashboard rendering 127.0.0.1:8788 with no comma.

title: iPad Dashboard formats local server port with thousands separator
